title: Array Constraints
description: Write SystemVerilog code using constraint: array size < 10 and array contents sum = 100. Create a class with random array and these constraints, then display valid arrays.
hint: Use 'rand int array[];' for dynamic array. Constraint should be: constraint c_array { array.size() == size; array.sum() == 100; }

title: Simple Assertions
description: Implement a simple checker with SystemVerilog assertions. Create assertions to verify that a signal never has X or Z values during active cycles.
hint: Use SystemVerilog assertion: assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (!rst_n) valid |-> !$isunknown(data));

title: FIFO with Basic Constraints
description: Implement a FIFO with basic SystemVerilog features. Use a class to model transactions with constraints on data values.
hint: Use constraint to prevent simultaneous read/write: constraint c_valid { !(wr_en && rd_en); }

title: Basic Coverage Example
description: Create a simple covergroup to track values of a 3-bit counter. Implement bins for different ranges.
hint: Create covergroup with coverpoints and bins. Sample coverage at appropriate points.
